title: Permutation in String
statement: Return true when `s2` contains a permutation of `s1` as a contiguous substring.
constraints: Both strings are lowercase English letters
hints: A permutation is a window of length len(s1) with the same character counts.
Compare a fixed-size window's counter with the counter of s1.
Slide by adding the incoming character and removing the outgoing one.

approaches.name: Sort every window
approaches.explanation: Sort s1 and each window of that length.

approaches.name: Fixed window counts
approaches.explanation: Maintain a frequency vector of size 26.

editorial: If s1 is longer than s2 the answer is false. Otherwise build two counters and slide a window of length len(s1). Equality of counters means the window is a permutation. Decrementing a count to zero should delete the key so dictionary equality stays exact.
